primary_contradiction.summary: The plan makes Session Project Binding immutable, but the physical filesystem, Project location, active Runs, deletion state and protocol retries remain mutable; the missing versioned lifecycle fences allow those mutable states to bypass the intended single workspace authority.

challenge_clusters.question: Can one tagged Session workspace resolution remain the sole authority through active-Run relocation, explicit execution roots, projectless dispatch and supported filesystem identity changes without modifying the public Harness SDK?
required_evidence: Host-to-SdkRunToolAuthority-to-ProductToolsAdapter-to-physical-handler call chain
complete workspace-required versus projectless-safe tool inventory
active Run plus Project relocation concurrency trace
macOS symlink/same-volume rename/different-directory raw spike
Windows equivalent-path and identity probe plan with executable command

challenge_clusters.question: What exact durable state machine and transaction boundary makes create, retry, Provider validation, deletion and same-id replay preserve an immutable binding without visible half states?
required_evidence: all current tables and transaction-owning methods touched by Session creation
Provider registry mutation-lock lifetime versus SQLite transaction lifetime
durable request-id claim/result schema and retention rule
foreign-key and ON DELETE policy for projects and bindings
failure injection matrix for every write and lost ACK
deleted Session replay and restart state transitions

challenge_clusters.question: What bounded read protocol preserves current product-history visibility while making zero-message Sessions visible and keeping a 500 by 200 dataset within query, payload and UI limits?
required_evidence: exact active/product-session SQL predicate including delivery and owner state
stable project and session sort keys plus cursor definitions
selected Session inclusion behavior across pages
100k-row EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN and p50/p95 benchmark
serialized page byte size and React virtualization/render measurement

challenge_clusters.question: How must schema v32 and semantic legacy backfill be phased so the documented persistence-version prerequisite is closed and any crash yields either a safely resumable or exactly restorable database?
required_evidence: current user_version and durable migration marker reconciliation
inventory of lazily created tables relevant to the new transaction
backfill phase/checkpoint/outcome representation
crash injection before, during and after schema/backfill commits
backup creation, validation and restore commands
two-run mixed legacy/new fixture comparison for messages titles Memory Provider delivery and ordering
